title: Favorite guitar and banjo players of his youth
summary: He names Willie San Diego, Lloyd Keppard, Lorenzo Stoll, Willie Bonte and Tom Benton, and says his brother John was praised by everyone.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section's changing role

blocks.x: Who were some of your favorite guitar and banjo players? Aside from your brother we know you must have thought John especially was wonderful everyone says.
Well everybody gave him that you know but not me I wouldn't brag about him.
So we know that he was great. And who were some of the others that you liked when you were a kid?

Well mostly fell there was a lot of guitar players like Willie San Diego. You know Mr. Willie San Diego. Also Mr. Lloyd Kepper. I know your name is Lloyd Kepper. Oh yes. Mr. Lloyd Kepper. A lot of other people I can't think about the name.
What about this fella Payne that you mentioned? Richard Payne. Was he really good?
Well I couldn't tell how good he was because I was too small. To remember he's called, you know he's playing when he was my dad and him. That's around 1910. About 10 years old.
You remember some of the fellas uptown like Brock Mumford. Brock who used to play with the Eagle Band.

No. Lorenzo Stoll. Oh Lorenzo Stoll. Yes I know him good. He was a nice musician too. Nice banjo player he was. He was a big banjo player. He was nice too. Also Willie Bonte. Oh yes. I forgot to mention his name. Willie Bonte was a nice guy too. Wonderful banjo player too. Remember Tom Benton.
Did he play banjo, guitar, mandolin or what did he do? Banjo.

But see Bill, when you called asked me this question then it comes to my remembrance. Yeah. But it's been so long I can't think about those girls guys. Sure. Yeah but really I know all them guys well. That was in my time.
